summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric utility, for the month of May 2026. It contains no event triggering a special situation—only forward-looking statements, a graphic attachment, and standard signature/cover pages. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is purely a periodic report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. No deal terms or transaction details are present.
